name: Sample_ID
description: A unique identifier assigned to each soil sample.

name: Upper_Depth_cm
description: The upper boundary of the sampled soil layer, measured in centimeters.

name: Lower_Depth_cm
description: The lower boundary of the sampled soil layer, measured in centimeters.

name: Reference
description: A citation or source reference related to the soil data, not explicitly defined in the context.

name: Plot
description: A designation for the specific area from which the soil sample is collected, not explicitly defined in the context.

name: pH_H2O
description: The pH of the soil measured in a water suspension, indicating soil acidity or alkalinity.

name: pH_KCl
element: pH of 1:5 soil/1M potassium chloride extract - direct (with stirring during measurement)
description: The pH of the soil measured in a potassium chloride solution, providing an alternative measure of soil acidity.

name: Electrical_Conductivity_mS_cm
description: The electrical conductivity of the soil, measured in milliSiemens per centimeter, indicating the soil's ability to conduct electricity.

name: Organic_Carbon_pct
description: The percentage of organic carbon content in the soil, measured as grams of carbon per 100 grams of soil.

name: Organic_Matter_pct
description: The percentage of organic matter in the soil, measured as grams of organic matter per 100 grams of soil.

name: Bulk_Density_g_cm3
description: The mass of soil per unit volume, measured in grams per cubic centimeter.

name: CN_Ratio
description: The ratio of carbon to nitrogen in the soil, a dimensionless value indicating the balance of these two elements.

name: Kjeldahl_Nitrogen_mg_kg
description: The total nitrogen content in the soil, measured using the Kjeldahl method, expressed in milligrams per kilogram.

name: Nitrate_Nitrogen_mg_kg
description: The concentration of nitrate nitrogen in the soil, measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: Ammonium_Nitrogen_mg_kg
description: The concentration of ammonium nitrogen in the soil, measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: Nitrogen_pct
description: The percentage of nitrogen content in the soil, measured as grams of nitrogen per 100 grams of soil.

name: Total_Nitrogen_mg_kg
description: The total nitrogen content in the soil, measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: Phosphorus_mg_kg
description: The concentration of phosphorus in the soil, measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: Potassium_meq_100g
description: The amount of potassium in the soil, measured in milliequivalents per 100 grams of soil.

name: Calcium_meq_100g
description: The amount of calcium in the soil, measured in milliequivalents per 100 grams of soil.

name: Magnesium_meq_100g
description: The amount of magnesium in the soil, measured in milliequivalents per 100 grams of soil.

name: Sodium_meq_100g
description: The amount of sodium in the soil, measured in milliequivalents per 100 grams of soil.

name: Boron_mg_kg
description: The concentration of boron in the soil, measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: Iron_mg_kg
description: The concentration of iron in the soil, measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: Copper_mg_kg
description: The concentration of copper in the soil, measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: Zinc_mg_kg
description: The concentration of zinc in the soil, measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: Manganese_mg_kg
description: The concentration of manganese in the soil, measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: Carbonates_pct
description: The percentage of carbonates in the soil, measured as grams of carbonates per 100 grams of soil.

name: CEC_meq_100g
description: The cation exchange capacity of the soil, measured in milliequivalents per 100 grams of soil.

name: Active_Lime_pct
description: The percentage of active lime in the soil, measured as grams of active lime per 100 grams of soil.

name: Clay_pct
description: The percentage of clay fraction in the soil, measured as grams of clay per 100 grams of soil.

name: Silt_pct
description: The percentage of silt fraction in the soil, measured as grams of silt per 100 grams of soil.

name: Sand_pct
description: The percentage of sand fraction in the soil, measured as grams of sand per 100 grams of soil.

name: Gravel_pct
description: The percentage of gravel in the soil, measured as grams of gravel per 100 grams of soil.

name: USDA_Classification
description: The classification of soil texture according to USDA standards.

name: CaMg_Ratio
description: The ratio of calcium to magnesium in the soil, a dimensionless value.

name: KMg_Ratio
description: The ratio of potassium to magnesium in the soil, a dimensionless value.

name: CaK_Ratio
description: The ratio of calcium to potassium in the soil, a dimensionless value.

name: Longitude_EPSG4326
description: The geographic longitude of the soil sampling point, expressed in decimal degrees using the WGS84 coordinate system.

name: Latitude_EPSG4326
description: The geographic latitude of the soil sampling point, expressed in decimal degrees using the WGS84 coordinate system.
